daily.name: Bright Moon
daily.text: The moon hangs low and obliging. Hands move quicker on the paths; Issa says the chart lines dry faster too.

daily.name: Grey Day
daily.text: Low cloud, good labor weather. Mara swears hammers swing truer under a grey sky.

daily.name: Harvest Day
daily.text: Full baskets before noon. The smokehouse sings, the tables groan, and Old Bell rings a half-hour longer.

daily.name: Ember Winds
daily.text: Warm wind off the forge hills. Lessons stick at Tam's stools and tempers hold at Sarella's rack.

daily.name: Still Night
daily.text: Not a leaf stirs. Wounds close clean and sleep comes easy.

daily.name: Wayfinder's Dawn
daily.text: Far ridges stand out sharp against the light. Scouts see everything.

daily.name: Market Eve
daily.text: Wagons on the road and coin in the air. Everyone packs an extra bundle.

seasons.name: Sowing
seasons.text: Seed rows drink the dusk. The fields give a little extra.

seasons.name: Timber
seasons.text: Axes bite deep this week. Every swing carries further.

seasons.name: Moonstone
seasons.text: The mine breathes cold and bright. Pockets feel deeper.

seasons.name: Mending
seasons.text: Hammers and bandages. The village knits itself whole.
